name: Netlify
one_liner: Web hosting and deployment platform for sites and apps, with a REST API, OpenAPI spec and official MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens and OAuth2 access tokens both sent as Authorization: Bearer; OAuth apps registered in user settings with client key and secret.
access_notes: Tokens and OAuth apps are self-serve in user settings; a Free plan is offered. Rate limit 500 req/min for most requests, deploys 3/min and 100/day.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve tokens and OAuth apps, documented REST API with OpenAPI spec, rate limits, outgoing webhooks and an official MCP server. Endpoint count not verified.

auth.quote: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication. All requests must use HTTPS.

api_surface.quote: You can make up to 500 requests per minute for most requests.
Netlify can trigger webhooks, send email notifications, or send Slack messages on certain events.

mcp.quote: Netlify MCP Server follows the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable code agents to use the Netlify API and CLI

disputes.why: Free plan 'free forever' on pricing page; tokens and OAuth apps self-serve.
Outgoing webhooks documented in notifications docs.
